results.title: Former Cochise GOP Chair, other 2020 ‘fake electors’ see charges dismissed
results.description: A Maricopa County judge dismisses charges against Arizona's 2020 Republican presidential electors at the request of Attorney General Kris Mayes but the charges could theoretically be refiled in the future.

results.title: House Democrats Propose Sweeping CYFD Overhaul Ahead of Legislative Session
results.description: The comprehensive legislation aims to increase transparency and accountability through body cameras, an independent commission, and expanded watchdog authority, while Republicans question the timing of the reforms.

results.title: ‘Stranger things have happened’: Trump coy on calling midterm-elections emergency
results.description: Donald Trump delivered a cryptic response when asked whether he would consider calling a national security emergency ahead of the midterm elections, giving oxygen to calls from right-wing pundits for an unprecedented intervention.
